TITLE: ProofOfWork — Student-Side Authorship Provenance + Binding Oral Micro-Defense
CLAIM: A student-owned writing workspace that captures tamper-evident process provenance AND, on demand, runs a 3-minute AI "micro-viva" that binds your draft's specific claims to your spoken explanation — producing a shareable credential a student presents proactively (or after a false AI-detection flag) to a skeptical professor.
RATIONALE: AI-detector false positives are a documented mass-harm event: detectors flagged 61% of genuine student essays in independent testing, ~223,500 US students falsely accused annually at just 1% error, UK ombudsman cases overturning zeros. Decisive technical insight: a Jan-2026 arxiv paper (2601.17280) proves keystroke-timing provenance is fundamentally broken (copy-type attack, >=99.8% evasion) and the ONLY viable defense "binds the observed writing process to the semantic content of the output" via revision-semantic-coherence + challenge-response. No shipped product does this binding: TypeTrace/Grammarly Authorship/Draftback/GPTZero Writing Report capture timing/keystrokes only (the broken layer); viva tools (vivacheck.org, VivaEdu, Oralify) are all teacher-assigned B2B.
STUDENT MOMENT: The 9am "I've been accused of using AI on a paper I actually wrote" panic — and the pre-emptive "bulletproof this before I submit" moment.
COMPETITORS: (a) Free ChatGPT/Gemini: can critique a draft but cannot produce a tamper-evident, content-bound provenance artifact about that specific session. (b) Grammarly Authorship + GPTZero Writing Report = keystroke/timing replay only (the layer arxiv 2601.17280 shows "cannot establish content provenance"). (c) vivacheck.org/VivaEdu/Oralify.ai = instructor-side B2B ("Teachers get structured reports," LMS-launched); TypeTrace/Realwork = timing-capture only. (d) Research: arxiv 2601.17280 proposes the content-binding architecture, ships no product. Gap: a STUDENT-OWNED, content-bound, pre-emptive credential.
CHATGPT-PROOF: Chat is stateless about your authorship session and cannot certify provenance. The value is a tamper-evident, timestamped artifact binding (revision history) x (semantic coherence across drafts) x (recorded oral micro-defense with questions generated from your exact sentences) — a verifiable credential, not a chat answer.
CORE AI: Three bound layers: (1) lightweight client-side revision/clipboard logging; (2) small model computing semantic-coherence deltas across saved drafts (does the argument develop, or does a finished block teleport in?); (3) LLM reading the final draft to generate 5-8 specific challenge questions ("you claim X in paragraph 3 — why this example over the obvious alternative?"), scoring whether the spoken answer demonstrates origination. Credential hashes all three.
INTEGRITY+TRUST: The trust-positive inverse of a cheating tool — exists to PROTECT honest students; operationalizes the exact alternative (authentic assessment, process-based verification, oral defenses) integrity researchers recommend over surveillance. A professor sees a tool that makes students defend their own ideas.
